subject: Next steps: Finova evaluation — stakeholder map + security evidence plan
messages:
From: Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.ai>
To: Samir Desai <samir@finova.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>, Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.ai>
Date: Sat, 9 May 2026 14:05:00 -0700
Subject: Next steps: Finova evaluation — stakeholder map + security evidence plan

Hi Samir — thanks again for the call earlier. Quick recap and proposed next steps so we have alignment: 

Call recap (10/10 clarity):
- Use case: Finova wants to add LLM-assisted transaction categorization and a contextual help layer inside agent dashboard (web UI + backend API).
- Decision criteria: accuracy on historical transactions, predictable latency under 200ms p50 for dashboard flows, and clear answers for data residency & audit logging.
- Economic buyer: you mentioned the CFO (Maya Kapoor) is likely final sign-off — please confirm.
- Procurement & legal: you said procurement@finova.com owns contracts; Asha (security) will handle technical intake.

Immediate asks / next steps:
1) Please confirm the economic buyer (name + email) and primary procurement contact.
2) I attached our security questionnaire (redwood-security-questionnaire-v1.pdf) and a blank evidence matrix. If you can share a primary security contact (or have them complete the questionnaire) we can route the kickoff appropriately.
3) Proposed kickoff: 60-minute security scoping session w/ Asha + engineering (we suggest Tue/Wed next week).

Scope we plan to evaluate (please flag additions):
- Systems in scope: transaction API, agent dashboard (frontend), reports pipeline that stores aggregated metadata (no PII expected to be stored in embeddings).
- Data residency: want to confirm whether Finova requires EU-only storage or will accept US regions.

I attached the questionnaire + an evidence-matrix template to make it easiest for your team to collect artifacts.

Attachments: redwood-security-questionnaire-v1.pdf (pdf), evidence-matrix.xlsx (xlsx)

Thanks — copying Marissa (CS) and Ben (solutions) to help coordinate technical follow-ups.

Best,
Laura Bennett
Enterprise Sales, Redwood Inference
laura_bennett@redwood.ai
Mobile: +1 (415) 555-0132

Hi Asha / procurement team — per Samir's intro, high level plan and a couple housekeeping notes ahead of the kickoff: 

What I'm sending now:
- redwood-security-questionnaire-v1.pdf (attached) — standard intake we use for initial scoping.
- evidence-matrix.xlsx (attached) — a template you can drop supporting artifacts into (SOC reports, encryption screenshots, config snippets).
- proposed systems-in-scope (quick list): payment API (transaction service), agent dashboard (react frontend + api gateway), reports ETL pipeline (aggregated metrics only).

Kickoff goals (60 min):
- Confirm systems-in-scope and data classification (PII, PCI, PHI).
- Clarify evidence expectations (SOC2 type II, encryption at rest screenshots, key management details).
- Agree a timeline for questionnaire completion and artifact delivery (we typically ask for the questionnaire back in 5 business days; evidence can follow).

Please let me know if the proposed kickoff time Samir suggested (Wed, May 13, 11:30am PT) works. If so I'll send a calendar invite with a Zoom link and an agenda.

Attachments: redwood-security-questionnaire-v1.pdf, evidence-matrix.xlsx

Thanks — Laura

From: Asha Menon <asha.menon@finova.com>

Date: Mon, 11 May 2026 10:12:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Redwood security questionnaire + proposed systems-in-scope (kickoff prep)

Laura / team — thanks for the materials. Asha here (Finova InfoSec). A few notes after a quick pass: 

1) Systems-in-scope confirmation:
- Payment API (transaction service) — in scope (stores tokenized IDs + small set of customer metadata).
- Agent dashboard — in scope for UI-level telemetry (no raw payment data).
- Reports pipeline — in scope for aggregated metrics.

2) Data classification / key asks:
- There is some limited PII (email, hashed customer id) and sensitive financial attributes; we'll need encryption-at-rest evidence and KMS ownership info.
- Finova requires that data for EU customers remain in EU regions — can Redwood restrict storage by dataset?

3) Evidence we need from Redwood (initial list):
- SOC 2 Type II report (most recent) or SOC bridge letter.
- KMS architecture / key ownership statement.
- Encryption-at-rest screenshots or config snippets.

4) Logistics & timeline:
- Kickoff Wed May 13, 11:30am PT works for me — please send calendar invite.
- We'll aim to have the questionnaire back to you by Tue May 18 EOD, with evidence links following by May 25. If Redwood needs faster turnaround, flag it.

Attachments: initial-system-inventory.csv (csv stub)

Asha Menon
InfoSec Lead, Finova
asha.menon@finova.com
